en: A colorized panoramic view over a small European town with red‑roofed houses and several church towers rising above the rooftops. In the foreground there is a rocky, sandy slope and dense greenery; in the background flat countryside stretches to the horizon. The title text "Ostritz i. Sa." appears in the upper left corner, suggesting the scene is the town of Ostritz in Saxony.
